_comment: Captured from karmaterminal/frond-alarm submit.sh at commit 32b40a23efa8e20696bfe4bcca4062901e447ad4 (blob 7a552eb8296dfd1580ca77694c87117f2b84dab9), run with REQUEST_ID set, against a fake gh that records its argv, beside a test princes.json mapping example-caller to example and other-caller to other. The fake issue number is 42. test_summon.py checks that summon.py writes the same title, label, body and wake for the same inputs.

vectors.name: default line, manual, live
args: Need paws on the build host: it is off the network and will not come back by itself.

```json

```
